generalPurposeChanges.sampledImplementationChallenge: Explicit stopCorrection.implementationChallengeMode=sampled selects a frozen deterministic cohort of at most3 eligible full-original-duty M16 implementation objects. Coverage is partial/nonexhaustive and semanticsVerified=false; otherwise-clean selected duties without required method evidence stay U. Existing D/U and validated conditional/noncurrent exclusions remain scoped skips without refill. Same reviewer, ACKs, ownership, current-source and original deadline; no automatic D/PASS or new retry/worker.
generalPurposeChanges.pendingReviewNavigation: Bounded review_checklist pending/process views and compact saved-receipt recovery expose exact existing IDs and diagnostic/proof-owner navigation without creating evidence or verdict authority. Required-production Map keys now remain string object IDs; the unreachable numeric-decorator insertion was removed defensively, with no demonstrated reachable crash claim.
generalPurposeChanges.typedM16RoleCompatibility: Challenge eligibility accepts omitted implementationRole only for the existing typed M16 IMPLEMENTATION production population, in both optional and sampled modes. Explicit TEST/SUPPORT, standing, foreign and malformed duties remain excluded. This compatibility fix is not evidence for the cause of earlier zero method calls.
generalPurposeChanges.defaultsAndGenerality: Absent and explicit optional modes preserve prior serialized defaults. Strict four flags, project/session defaults, caps2/2 and original budgets are unchanged. No task IDs, benchmark dispatch rules, private grader outcomes or forced semantic dispositions are added.
generalPurposeChanges.taskStateLockTimeoutDiagnostics: Only the task-store producer typed TASK_STATE_LOCK_TIMEOUT receives phase-specific static feedback. The original host tool result is retained on the tool-result path. No raw lock path or error-message body enters this diagnostic; deadlines, lock contention behavior, model budgets and acceptance rules are unchanged. No real-model efficacy is established.
